description_en: Adds one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances to a scaling group
kebab_example: aliyun ess attach-db-instances --scaling-group-id asg-bp1avr6ensitts3w0000 --db-instance rm-bp12cy30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachDBInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add the private IP addresses of all instances in the current scaling group to the IP address whitelist of the ApsaraDB RDS instances when the ApsaraDB RDS instances are added to the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Add the private IP addresses.

false: Do not add the private IP addresses.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
当RDS实例添加到伸缩组时，是否把当前伸缩组内实例的私网IP全部添加到RDS实例IP白名单中。取值范围：

true：添加。

false：不添加。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_attach

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotence of the request.

You can generate the value on your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of ApsaraDB RDS instance N. Valid values of N: 1 to 5
parameters.name: db_instance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The association mode between the scaling group and the database. Valid values:

SecurityIp: IP address whitelist mode. The scaling group is associated with the database by automatically adding the scaled-out instances to the database whitelist. Only ApsaraDB RDS databases are supported.
SecurityGroup: Security group mode. The scaling group is associated with the database by adding the security group of the scaling configuration to the security group whitelist of the database. This allows instances in the security group to access the database.

Default value: SecurityIp
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组与数据库关联方式。取值范围：

SecurityIp：修改IP白名单模式，通过将扩容实例自动添加到数据库白名单（目前仅RDS数据库支持）进行关联。
SecurityGroup：安全组模式，通过将伸缩配置安全组添加至数据库安全组白名单进行关联，实现安全组下实例数据库访问。

默认值：SecurityIp
parameters.name: attach_mode

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:

RDS
Redis
MongoDB

Default value: RDS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型。取值范围：

RDS。
Redis。
MongoDB。

默认值：RDS
